body: `agx sessions move` refuses while any Claude process has its cwd in the folder ('Claude is running in this folder (pid N) - exit it first'), because a live session keeps appending to its .jsonl and a move would split the history (provider/claude/alive_*.go). --only <id> may move a conversation while an unrelated one in the folder is live. Fix path: the user exits it with /exit, or with approval send SIGTERM (not SIGKILL) so Claude flushes its transcript; stopping a --remote-control session ends its remote link (seen 2026-09-30).
